claims: Super is payable on casual earnings at the SG rate regardless of hours worked.
whys: The $450 monthly threshold is gone, but employees under 18 are only owed SG if they work more than 30 hours in a week. So 'regardless of hours worked' is wrong for under-18 casuals.
constants: SUPER_GUARANTEE (an under-18 30-hours rule field) in lib/constants

claims: The ATO recommends keeping payslips for a minimum of 5 years from the date you lodge the relevant tax return.
whys: The ATO states the 5-year record-keeping period as a requirement, not a recommendation. The wording may understate the rule. Left unchanged per the no-change-to-facts rule.
constants: Record-keeping period (5 years) is typed in prose, with no constant

claims: The Fair Work Act requires employers to itemise each component of pay separately, including base hours, overtime hours, penalty rate loadings, and any allowances.
whys: The itemised payslip content comes from Fair Work Regulations 2009 reg 3.46, which the legal-content FAQ on line 40 correctly cites, not the Act. reg 3.46 also does not literally require 'overtime hours' as a separate line. This needs a citation check.

claims: Often not. ... many payslips bundle this amount into the PAYG withholding line.
whys: This is a population claim with no figure or cited source, and it is the opening answer of the FAQ.
